# Descriptions
@@ 1
This spell alIows the caster to make an attack in the current Snap Action
Phase without the -20 penalty. The attack occurs as part of this spell (i.e.,
no separate action need be declared). The maximum OB for this attack is 90%
(which results in a -10 attack).
@@ 2
Caster may divide his parry between up to two melee attackers with no penalty.
@@ 3
Caster may move up to 30% normal movement and attack without suffering a
penalty to his OB.
@@ 4
Caster may attack and pany as normal and then perform a diving roll to a
location up to 20' away from his starting point. This maneuver is part of the
attack and requires no extra percentage activity (or declared action).
@@ 5
Casters next attack this round delivers 1.5x concussion hits.
@@ 6
Caster may parry this round with 125% of his OB; however, the caster may not
attack this round.
@@ 7
If the casters next attack this round inflicts a critical, it will cause 1 hit
per round of bleeding in addition to any other critical results. This spell
will have no effect on creatures that are normally immune to bleeding wounds
(golems, constructs, undead, etc.).
@@ 8
As Split Parry II, except caster may divide his parry between up to three
attackers.
@@ 9
If the target ofthe casters next melee attack this round parries with a weapon
or shield, it must immediately make a breakage check modified by -20.
@@ 10
Caster can divide his melee OB in any proportion he desires and attack two
separate targets with no penalty as long as both are within normal melee range
and neither of the targets is positioned to the caster's rear.
@@ 11
If the casters next attack this round inflicts a critical, it will cause 1
round of stun in addition to all other critical results. This spell has no
effect on creatures that are normally immune to stun.
@@ 12
As Tumble Evasion I, except caster may end up in a location 50' away.
@@ 13
As Moving Strike I, except caster may move up to 70% normal movement.
@@ 14
As Hammer Strike I, except delivers double concussion hits.
@@ 15
As Survival Instinct I, except caster may parry with 150% ofhis normal OB.
@@ 16
As Bleeding Strike I, except 2 hits/rnd are caused in addition to all other
critical results.
@@ 17
If the caster parries a melee attack this round, and the melee attack does not
inflict any damage, he may attack back with 50% of his normal OB immediately
following the opponent's attack. This riposte attack requires a action of its
own, but may be made in addition to any other attack this round. For example,
the caster could cast this spell, attack with 90% OB, and then riposte with
50% OB.
@@ 18
As Shatter Strike I, except the weapon or shield must make the breakage check
modified by -50.
@@ 20
As Split Parry II, except caster may divide his parry between up to four
attackers.
@@ 30
As Split Attack II, except caster can attack up to three separate targets as
long as all three are within normal melee range and none of the foes is to the
caster's rear.
@@ 50
Caster may utilize any one ofthe lower level spells on this list once per
round.
